aboutText: Canopy Cleaning, based in Campbellfield, has been providing expert HVAC services for over 25 years. Our team understands the unique air quality challenges in Melbourne's north, offering tailored solutions for kitchen exhaust, duct compliance, and indoor air quality. We pride ourselves on reliable, professional service that keeps your air clean and safe.
servicesText: From kitchen exhaust canopies to HVAC ducts, we offer comprehensive cleaning and compliance programs. Our services ensure your systems meet safety standards and operate efficiently, protecting your property and health.
